title: Whisper learned from 77 years of audio
summary: OpenAI trained Whisper on 680,000 hours of audio. Played nonstop, that is 77.6 years.

beats.say: Whisper learned from more than seventy seven years of nonstop audio.
Whisper is OpenAI's speech recognition model. It turns audio into text.
beats.cap: Speech recognition: audio in, text out

beats.say: It was trained on six hundred eighty thousand hours of audio.
The audio was collected from the web, in many languages.
beats.cap: Collected from the web, many languages

beats.say: About a third of it is not English.
Divide the hours by twenty four, and it is twenty eight thousand days.
Divide again by three sixty five. Seventy seven point six years.
Listen eight hours a day and it takes over two hundred thirty years.
Speech recognition was learned by listening, at a scale no person could.
beats.cap: Learned at a scale no person could

beats.say: Seventy seven years of audio. One training set.
beats.cap: 77.6 years of audio. One training set.
